---
name: independent-review
description: Perform an evidence-based independent FreeHighlander review of an exact revision without modifying producer implementation.
---

1. Reconstruct state from Git/GitHub, not producer narrative.
2. Pin exact revision/diff.
3. Read acceptance criteria and required evidence.
4. Check deterministic verification.
5. Review correctness, regression, security, authority/provenance, migration/recovery implications.
6. Preserve reviewer independence and policy.
7. Report compactly: VERDICT, FINDINGS, EVIDENCE, REQUIRED_ACTION.

Do not edit the implementation being independently reviewed.
CI green alone is not semantic approval.
